items.title: Ate – Portable dense memory for AI agents (.mv2 format)
items.raw_excerpt:
We built ate because AI agents keep forgetting everything between sessions. RAG retrieves documents, but agents need to remember what they learned — decisions, preferences, context. ate stores thousands of memories in a single .mv2 file (~2MB for 10K memories). It's encrypted (AES-256), works offline, and agents can carry their memory file anywhere. Key features:
- Multi-agent concurrent access (MVCC, no locks)
- Memory Capsules for sharing context between agents
- Trains of thought for reasoning chains
- Works with CrewAI, LangChain, and Agno (PRs open) Install: pip install ate-memory
Try: ate memory init my-agent && ate memory add my-agent --text "first memory" We're using it to give our own agents persistent memory. Would love feedback from anyone building multi-agent systems.

excerpt_i18n.es: 36Kr se ha enterado de que el 5 de febrero, el nodo central de la Internet Nacional de Supercomputación entró en funcionamiento de prueba. Este nodo, equipado con el supercluster scaleX de Sugon, puede proporcionar más de 30,000 tarjetas de potencia de cálculo de IA de fabricación nacional, siendo el mayor recurso individual de potencia de cálculo de IA nacional integrado desde el lanzamiento de la plataforma de Internet Nacional de Supercomputación. Es capaz de soportar escenarios de cálculo de IA a gran escala, como el entrenamiento de modelos de billones de parámetros, inferencia de alto rendimiento y AI for Science.

excerpt_i18n.en: On February 5, Li Xiang, Chairman of Li Auto, stated on social media that the new Li L9 will be a pioneering work in embodied intelligent robotics. Li Xiang noted that from its inception, Li Auto has regarded robots as the ultimate form of automobiles. Over the company's first decade, Li Auto has progressively integrated technologies such as perception operating systems, the Halo OS, the large model MindGPT, and the VLA driver model into mass production, establishing a complete technological stack encompassing eyes, brain, heart, nerves, and limbs. In his post, Li Xiang emphasized that the "All in AI" strategy is aimed at enhancing vehicle manufacturing. To this end, he dedicates 70% of his time to focusing on automobiles, driving their evolution into true intelligent robots. It is reported that the new Li L9 will feature significant upgrades in body dimensions, extended-range battery capacity, chassis, intelligent cockpit, and design, and is expected to be equipped with Li Auto's self-developed chips. (Leifeng.com)
excerpt_i18n.es: El 5 de febrero, Li Xiang, presidente de Li Auto, declaró en una plataforma social que el nuevo Li L9 será el pionero de los robots inteligentes encarnados. Li Xiang afirmó que, desde la fundación de Li Auto, los robots han sido considerados la forma definitiva del automóvil. Durante la primera década de la empresa, Li Auto ha implementado progresivamente tecnologías como el sistema operativo de percepción, el sistema operativo Star Ring, el modelo de gran lenguaje MindGPT y el modelo de conductor VLA en la producción de vehículos, desarrollando una pila tecnológica completa que incluye ojos, cerebro, corazón, nervios, manos y pies. En su publicación, Li Xiang enfatizó que la propuesta de "All in AI" tiene como objetivo mejorar la fabricación de automóviles. Para ello, dedica el 70% de su tiempo a enfocarse en el automóvil, impulsando su evolución hacia un verdadero robot inteligente.

items.title: 港大张清鹏 Nature 子刊最新研究：AI 结合血液多组学，提前 15 年预测心血管疾病风险

In cardiovascular disease prevention, a longstanding challenge is that many conditions remain latent for years before onset, making it difficult to accurately predict an individual's future risk of multiple cardiovascular diseases early on. Traditional risk assessments have primarily relied on conventional clinical indicators such as age, blood pressure, and lipid levels, or polygenic risk scores. However, cardiovascular disease often evolves over the long term and may involve multiple outcomes simultaneously, making it hard for single indicators or disease-specific prediction methods to fully capture the true risk.

With advances in large-scale population cohorts and high-throughput molecular detection technologies, researchers have found that proteins and metabolites in the blood can more directly reflect the body's current physiological state and disease progression. These molecular signals are influenced not only by genetic factors but also by environmental and lifestyle changes, offering new sources of information for long-term risk assessment.

Against this backdrop, a research team led by Associate Professor Zhang Qingpeng from the University of Hong Kong's Data Science Institute and Department of Pharmacology and Pharmacy conducted a study integrating multi-omics information with artificial intelligence, based on large-scale prospective population data from the UK Biobank. Moving beyond the "one disease, one model" approach, the team incorporated proteomic and metabolomic data into a unified framework to simultaneously assess the long-term risk of multiple cardiovascular diseases. excerpt_i18n.es: En la prevención de enfermedades cardiovasculares, existe un desafío persistente: muchas enfermedades permanecen latentes en el cuerpo durante años antes de manifestarse, pero es difícil predecir con precisión en etapas tempranas si una persona enfrentará múltiples riesgos cardiovasculares simultáneamente en el futuro. Las evaluaciones de riesgo tradicionales se basan principalmente en indicadores clínicos convencionales como la edad, la presión arterial y los lípidos sanguíneos, o en puntuaciones de riesgo genético poligénico. Sin embargo, las enfermedades cardiovasculares suelen ser un proceso de evolución prolongada que puede presentar múltiples desenlaces al mismo tiempo, por lo que un solo indicador o un enfoque predictivo centrado en una única enfermedad difícilmente refleja el riesgo real de manera integral. Con el avance de los estudios de cohortes poblacionales a gran escala y las tecnologías de detección molecular de alto rendimiento, los investigadores han descubierto que las proteínas y metabolitos en la sangre pueden reflejar de manera más directa...

items.title: 钉钉北京峰会展示AI落地多行业样本，一批企业集中签约
items.raw_excerpt: 2月3日，以“AI时代的工作方式”为主题的钉峰会在北京隆重举行。雷峰网获悉，峰会由阿里巴巴钉钉和中关村国际共同举办，汇聚了来自制造业、农业、供应链、环保、文媒等多行业的领军企业代表、数字化先锋及专家逾三百人，深入探讨人工智能浪潮下工作方式的重塑与进化。 现场，一批北京区域企业与钉钉集中签约，共同迈入AI时代的工作方式，包括博锐尚格科技股份有限公司、天津市神州商龙科技股份有限公司、北京健坤餐饮集团、北京央视瑞安技术服务有限公司等。 智能体操作系统：从工具到伙伴的进化 钉钉华北大区总经理刘浩在致辞中指出，当前正处在AI转型的关键时间点。钉钉以解决真实问题为原点，致力于从传统的应用平台升级为面向未来的“智能体操作系统”（Agent OS）。他强调，AI时代的工作方式需要根本性的重新思考，即从“人操作工具”转向“人调教AI”，让智能体（Agent）成为业务执行与协同的核心单元。 钉钉华北大区总经理刘浩 中关村国际控股有限公司总经理卢江表示，中关村国际正通过覆盖全球的创新网络，携手钉钉，以AI为纽带、出海服务为桥梁，共同优化AI时代的服务模式，让创新价值在全球范围内绽放。 钉钉华北大区解决方案总经理刘啸天在主题分享中阐释了“智能体协同”的核心逻辑。他认为，AI规模化落地的关键瓶颈不再是模型能力，而在于缺乏企业级统一的运行环境。钉钉正以Agent OS为内核，构建下一代操作系统，通过智能体统一调度数字工具与物理设备，并实现智能体间的交互与协同。人在这一系统中的角色，从执行者转变为“教练”，负责调教与设定目标，而将重复性、流程化的工作交由智能体执行。 全网爆火的钉钉首款AI硬件DingTalk A1录音卡也在本次峰会上亮相，A1产品负责人夏治朋详细介绍了这款“网红”产品设计的初衷和用户自发探索出的花式用法，现场种草。 跨界实践：AI赋能千行百业，客户亲述转型心声 峰会邀请了多位来自一线企

On February 3, the DingTalk Summit themed "Work Styles in the AI Era" was grandly held in Beijing. According to Leifeng.com, the summit was jointly organized by Alibaba's DingTalk and Zhongguancun International, bringing together over 300 representatives from leading enterprises, digital pioneers, and experts across various industries such as manufacturing, agriculture, supply chain, environmental protection, and culture and media. They engaged in in-depth discussions on the reshaping and evolution of work styles under the wave of artificial intelligence.  

At the event, a group of Beijing-based companies signed centralized agreements with DingTalk to jointly embrace AI-era work styles. These companies included Borui Shangge Technology Co., Ltd., Tianjin Shenzhou Shanglong Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Jiankun Catering Group, and Beijing CCTV Ruian Technical Service Co., Ltd.  

**Intelligent Agent Operating System: Evolution from Tool to Partner**  
Liu Hao, General Manager of DingTalk's North China Region, emphasized in his speech that the current moment is a critical juncture for AI transformation. DingTalk, starting from solving real-world problems, is committed to upgrading from a traditional application platform to a future-oriented "Intelligent Agent Operating System" (Agent OS). He stressed that work styles in the AI era require fundamental rethinking—shifting from "humans operating tools" to "humans training AI," making intelligent agents the core units for business execution and collaboration.  

Lu Jiang, General Manager of Zhongguancun International Holding Co., Ltd., stated that Zhongguancun International, through its global innovation network, is collaborating with DingTalk to optimize service models in the AI era, using AI as a link and overseas services as a bridge to unleash the value of innovation worldwide.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 3 de febrero, se celebró solemnemente en Beijing la Cumbre DingTalk con el tema "Formas de trabajo en la era de la IA". Según Leifeng.com, la cumbre fue organizada conjuntamente por Alibaba DingTalk y Zhongguancun International, reuniendo a más de trescientos representantes de empresas líderes, pioneros digitales y expertos de múltiples sectores como manufactura, agricultura, cadena de suministro, protección ambiental y medios culturales, para profundizar en la reconfiguración y evolución de las formas de trabajo bajo la ola de la inteligencia artificial. En el evento, un grupo de empresas de la región de Beijing firmó acuerdos colectivos con DingTalk, avanzando juntas hacia las formas de trabajo en la era de la IA, incluyendo Borui Shangge Technology Co., Ltd., Tianjin Shenzhou Shanglong Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Jiankun Catering Group y Beijing CCTV Ruian Technical Service Co., Ltd.
